app.name: Transcendence
app.tagline: Find and erase your data online.

welcome.title: Find what the internet knows about you. Then erase it.
welcome.subtitle: Transcendence finds the organisations that hold your personal data, scores the risk, writes the legal erasure request for you and tracks the one-month deadline.

find.title: Find
find.body: We look for your data at data brokers, search engines and social networks, and in known data breaches.

score.title: Score
score.body: Each organisation gets a risk score from 0 to 100, so you know where to start.

request.title: Request
request.body: We write a GDPR erasure letter that cites the right articles, ready to send to the organisation's data protection officer.

track.title: Track
track.body: The organisation has one month to answer. We count the days and tell you when the deadline has passed.

law.label: Your right
law.text: Under Article 17 of the GDPR, you can ask any organisation that processes your personal data to erase it. It must answer within one month, free of charge.

promises.title: Our commitments
items: No ads, no trackers, no third-party fonts.
Your data is never sold or shared.
Export all your data as JSON at any time.
Delete your account whenever you want, and your data goes with it.

welcome.final: Ready to take your data back?

dossier.title: This is your dossier
dossier.body: Every organisation that holds data about you is listed here, with its type and the status of your request.

risk.title: Read the risk score
risk.body: The higher the score, the more exposed your data is. Start with the red ones: data brokers and breaches first.

request.title: Send a request, we count the days
request.body: Press {{start}} next to an organisation: we prepare the letter, you send it. The bar then fills up over the 30 days the organisation has to answer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Transcendence helps you find and erase your personal data online. To do that, we have to handle some of your data ourselves. This page explains what we collect, why, and how you stay in control.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Your account details (name, email, hashed password), the search results about you (sites, data brokers, breaches), the erasure requests you send through the app, and the API keys you create (we only store a hash of them).

sections.title: Why we collect it
sections.body: Only to run the service: find where your data appears, score the risk, prepare erasure requests and notify you of their progress. We never sell your data and never use it for advertising.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: As long as your account exists. When you delete your account, all your data is deleted from our database.

sections.title: Your rights (GDPR)
sections.body: You can access, export, correct or delete your data at any time from your profile page. You can also contact the team to exercise these rights.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: By creating an account on Transcendence, you accept these terms.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: Transcendence finds public traces of your personal data and helps you write erasure requests. It is a student project: results can be incomplete and no outcome is guaranteed.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You must give accurate information and keep your password secret. You can only search for and request the erasure of your own data.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not use the service to collect data about other people, to send abusive requests, or to attack the platform or its public API.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change. If they do, we will notify you in the app.
